tasks.title: Announcement #54
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a university club meeting.
tasks.transcript: Welcome, everyone. Just a reminder that our club's annual hiking trip will be this Saturday. We'll meet at 8 AM at the Student Center and head out to the trails together. Make sure to bring water, snacks and comfortable shoes.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：Just a reminder that our club's annual hiking trip will be this Saturday. 选项分析： A. An upcoming hiking trip 一次即将到来的徒步旅行。公告明确告知俱乐部年度徒步旅行的安排，所以A选项正确。 B. A club meeting 一次俱乐部会议。公告是在俱乐部会议上宣读的，但内容是关于徒步旅行，而非会议本身，所以B选项错误。 C. A new club initiative 一项新的俱乐部倡议。公告提到的是“annual”（年度）活动，不是新倡议，所以C选项错误。 D. A student orientation 一次新生入学导向活动。公告中未提及新生或入学导向，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker suggest members bring?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：说话者建议成员带什么？ 定位原文：Make sure to bring water, snacks and comfortable shoes. 选项分析： A. Maps and sunscreen 地图和防晒霜。公告中未提及地图和防晒霜，所以A选项错误。 B. Tents and sleeping bags 帐篷和睡袋。公告中是单日徒步，未提及过夜装备，所以B选项错误。 C. Water, snacks, and comfortable shoes 水、零食和舒适的鞋子。说话者明确列出这三样物品，所以C选项正确。 D. Books and notebooks 书和笔记本。公告中未提及书籍或笔记本，所以D选项错误。
